comments.author: MaynardJamesKeenan
comments.body_html: Hello, Im a bit new to SPT and the concept of downloading mods and moving files into the correct folders. Could someone kindly explain what to do after I download this mod?

comments.author: scrptedPixel
comments.body_html:
Most mods follow the same structure: just drag & drop the archive contents into your installation folder.

In the same location as your SPT launcher and server, you’ll find the BepInEx/plugins/ folder (for client mods) and user/mods/ (for server mods).

This mod is a server mod (you can tell because the archive contains a user folder). Just extract it into the main installation directory – that’s all.

Client mods are usually a single .dll file (like BepInEx/plugins/example.dll), while server mods are typically folders with a package.json and other files (e.g. user/mods/spring-FairFight_BrainRebalance).

Rule of thumb: for most mods, drag & drop is all you need. If you don’t see a BepInEx or user folder in the archive, place the files manually into BepInEx/plugins or user/mods.
